subject: MSA + Order Form: capacity reallocation, pricing reconciliation, and SOW edits
messages:
From: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@brightwave.ai>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Marc Nguyen <marc.nguyen@brightwave.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: MSA and Order Form redlines attached — capacity shift request

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We reviewed the MSA + Order Form with our procurement and infra teams and attached a consolidated redline and an updated quantity table. Two quick items to highlight:

- We need to shift 200 GPU hours/month from Q4 to Q3 (start Sept 1) due to a product launch. Can you confirm whether that will change our per-token pricing tiers?
- We proposed a 6-month phased ramp in Exhibit A with milestone-based acceptance — see page 2 of the SOW draft. Can Redwood confirm you’ll accept the milestone language?

I’ve attached BrightWave_MSA_redline_v3.docx and OrderForm_QuantityTable_v2.xlsx. Our procurement would like a response by EOD Monday to meet our internal procurement cycle.

Thanks,
Ellie Ramos
Head of Procurement
BrightWave Analytics

Attachments: BrightWave_MSA_redline_v3.docx (docx, ~45KB), OrderForm_QuantityTable_v2.xlsx (xlsx, ~12KB)
From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@brightwave.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 12:38:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MSA and Order Form redlines attached — capacity shift request

Ellie — thanks for the redlines and the heads-up on timing. Looping in legal (Lauren) and our contracts lead (Priyom) to get eyes on the MSA clauses you edited.

Quick answers up front:
- Capacity shift: we can reallocate the 200 GPU hours into Q3; we need to confirm whether that qualifies as a one-time top-up vs a change to committed monthly throughput. That distinction affects billing and pro-ration.
- Milestone-based SOW: we generally support milestone acceptance in SOW exhibits but need to align on the acceptance tests and rollback triggers.

Requesting: Lauren/priyom — please review the liability cap edits on §9, the data retention clause in §12, and the proposed milestone acceptance language in Exhibit A. Ellie — can you confirm who will own acceptance sign-off for each milestone (PM or Eng)?

I’ll prepare a short mutual action plan once legal confirms the permitted edits.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0194

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@brightwave.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 7 Aug 2027 08:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MSA and Order Form redlines attached — capacity shift request

Camila / Ellie — quick legal read. High-level comments below; detailed redline tracked in BrightWave_MSA_redline_v3_LB-comments.docx (uploaded).

- Liability cap (§9): BrightWave has reduced the cap below our standard. We can accept a tiered cap tied to committed spend (e.g., 3x monthly committed spend) rather than a flat number, but we need to preserve carve-outs for gross negligence and willful misconduct.
- Data retention (§12): request to change retention to 365 days. We are willing to compromise at 540 days for analytics customers with a signed DPA addendum; otherwise keep 90-day default. Need the customer to sign DPA.
- Milestone language (Exhibit A): acceptable if acceptance tests are objective (API latency <X ms, model quality thresholds defined). We need explicit rollback and remediation windows.

Action items for BrightWave: please indicate acceptance owners per milestone and confirm whether they will sign a DPA. For billing: Priyom — please advise whether the capacity move should be billed as a one-time top-up (non-recurring) vs committed monthly amendment.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Attachment: BrightWave_MSA_redline_v3_LB-comments.docx (docx, ~18KB)
From: Marc Nguyen <marc.nguyen@brightwave.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@brightwave.ai>, finance@brightwave.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA and Order Form redlines attached — capacity shift request

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the clear options. A few clarifications from our side:

- Liability cap: BrightWave cannot accept a 3x committed spend cap; our procurement policy caps supplier liability at $500K for commercial contracts. We can sign a DPA and accept standard carve-outs if Redwood can agree to a $500K cap (our legal says anything higher requires board approval).
- DPA: we are willing to sign the DPA with a 540-day retention for this workload.
- Acceptance owners: Product Manager (S. Patel) will sign off functional acceptance; Engineering Lead (M. Nguyen) will own test evidence.
- Billing: finance@brightwave.ai requests that the 200 GPU hours moved into Q3 be invoiced as a one-time prepay credit on the Sept invoice (not an amendment to committed spend).

We are targeting signature by EOD Tuesday (11 Aug). If Redwood can confirm liability cap and invoicing treatment, we will push to sign.

—Marc
Marc Nguyen
VP, Platform Engineering | BrightWave Analytics
marc.nguyen@brightwave.ai

Attachment: none

Ellie / Marc — great, thanks for the quick clarifications and for assigning acceptance owners. Summary and next steps below so we can keep the procurement cycle moving: 

Summary of decisions
- Liability cap: Redwood legal can accept $500K cap for this specific deal provided BrightWave signs the DPA and we include carve-outs for gross negligence/willful misconduct. Lauren will prepare the final language this afternoon.
- Data retention / DPA: BrightWave has agreed to 540-day retention under a signed DPA. Lauren: please attach the DPA to the redline packet.
- Capacity: Redwood will treat the 200 GPU hours moved into Q3 as a one-time prepay credit on the Sept invoice (non-recurring). Priyom will confirm billing proration schedule and provide an invoice stub by EOD Monday.
- Milestones / SOW: Product sign-off owners confirmed (S. Patel and M. Nguyen). Camila to produce a short acceptance checklist for Exhibit A with objective test criteria.

Mutual action plan (timeline)
- Today (Mon 9 Aug): Lauren to finalize MSA language and DPA attachment; Priyom to prepare invoice stub showing one-time credit.
- Tue 10 Aug by 12:00 PT: BrightWave to confirm final sign-off and routing for DocuSign.
- Tue 10 Aug EOD: Target for signature and kickoff.

Deliverables attached: SOW-exhibit-A-draft.pdf (acceptance checklist placeholder). Once Lauren sends the final MSA redline and Priyom sends the invoice stub, we’ll generate the DocuSign package and send it to your procurement routing.

If anyone needs to escalate, please let me know — I can loop in my manager.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
